m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Great Sands! What's this? Snake Plizkin? We thought you was dead!
Yeah, well... surprise! Thought I'd come back and pay you knuckleheads a visit. Where's the Warden? We just need a minute of his time.
Uhh... we can't just let you into his office... I don't think. No, no, I think we're supposed to escort you back to your cell! Come on, Boas!
About time those bloated scale-bags got a taste of their own venom. They knocked me around every day in here. Now, where's that Warden?
Snake Plizkin. I knew you'd return. Those absurd rumors of your death... no, I knew fate would bring you back. Tetrus Prison is where you belong.
I appreciate the offer, Warden, but I'm just passing through. Here to see a friend, well, sort of. Don't suppose you'd hand over the Cell Key?
Silly Snake, you always were prone to delusion. You'll see things clearly after a few years in isolation. Guards, subdue the prisoner.
You got the Cell Key? Good. I spent enough time in Tetrus Prison before this visit, so I say we wrap this up quick. Let's get the girl and get out.
Wait a minute. You really did all this for me? What's the catch? You want something, don't you? Yep. I see it in your beady little eye.
Hey! How bout a little respect? Look, Qhitten, maybe not everyone's out to get you. How do you know this wasn't from the goodness of our hearts?
Because you're a Snake, and don't call me "Qhitten". Cough it up, Wizard - what's your angle? Wait. You want to overthrow my father? Seriously?
Well, all right then! The Baron's mad as a dried-out Dromel. I'm in. Just one thing we have to do first. Meet me in the street and I'll explain.
What's she thinking running out into the street like that? Crazy Qhat! Hm. Maybe she's not so bad after all. C'mon. We'd better go after her.
So we got a Mongu, a Wizard, and a Snake with an eyepatch. You're a ragtag bunch... my kind of crowd. Not saying I trust you, but it's a start.
Don't get me wrong. I mean, I like to get rescued as much as the next girl, but I just don't know if you really got what it takes, you know?
Hold it right there, little miss sunshine. You're questioning our qualifications? I busted out of this prison before, and I can do it again.
Wait... you're Snake Pliskin? I heard you were dead. Hmmph. Look, I'm not trying to threaten your exaggerated sense of self-worth.
All I'm saying is freeing me isn't as easy as you think. I mean, hello, you need to get the Cell Key from the Warden before we can do anything.
Oh, I got it. Snake, since you're old friends, maybe he'll just hand it over? Anyways, Armory's that way. I'm not going anywhere.
You back for some more polite conversation? No offense, but I'm not really in the mood. Either get that Key from the Armory or get out.
